lines.say: Stop doing past papers like this.
Do a paper. Mark it. Feel awful. Next one.
The marks you lost? That's the whole point.
Turn each one into a flashcard.
Redo it in three days. Then in a week.
That's spacing. It's how memory actually sticks.
Offload builds you a remediation deck for exactly this.
Comment papers and I'll send you the method.
